newsitem.title: UK: Brixton buys property at UK Gatwick airport.
newsitem.headline: Brixton buys property at UK Gatwick airport.

text.p: Brixton Estate Plc said on Thursday it had acquired Gatwick Gate Industrial Estate, Crawley from BBC Pension Trust Ltd for 10.3 million stg, at an initial yield of 9.8 percent.

The 142,000 sqare foot estate, which is immediately south of Gatwick Airport, produces rental income of just over one million stg, 71 percent of which is derived from leases with unexpired terms of 20 years.

The acquisition increases Brixton's holding in the Gatwick area to over 360,000 square feet and and follows its strategy of acquiring industrial estates in the south east of the UK, Brixton said in a statement.
